title: Framepick by BPJ
description: English discovery of AI films and series through official festival selections and publisher showcases.

methodology.scope: English-language discovery for international viewers and creators. These are global works, not a measured US or European popularity chart.
methodology.ranking: Browse each source and festival edition separately. Award labels reflect that source only. Catalogue order is not an audience ranking; publisher showcases are unranked.
methodology.metrics: No cross-platform views, audience geography, trending score or predicted success is available. Missing data remains unknown.
methodology.dates: Year identifies the festival or showcase edition. Source publication dates appear only when explicit; checked dates record metadata review, not release date.
methodology.genres: Genre labels and short descriptions are BPJ editorial summaries based on official source descriptions. An empty genre list means insufficient source detail.
methodology.ai: AI classification comes from the organizer or publisher. It does not establish that all frames were generated or independently verify the production workflow.
methodology.media: Watch on official linked pages. Films, episodes, trailers and source pages are labelled separately. Posters are remote references to the festival’s own images, with YouTube thumbnail fallbacks where available. Other cards use original typography. No film or third-party image is rehosted; no redistribution licence is claimed.
methodology.access: Player availability, spoken language, subtitles and regional access are not independently verified. Some source pages may require sign-in for further content.
methodology.business: The directory is free. Official viewing links are not paid placements or commission evidence.
